findings: Audit scope is analytics/metrics only. No provider history, credentials, environment files, personal runtime, network calls, application windows or models accessed. No tests executed for this read-only inventory.

Color is component-specific: ready means a bounded source/helper contract with historical passing evidence and reviewed implementation; it never certifies beta/native/installed readiness. partial includes implemented but unqualified features. absent marks the missing measured adapter, not absence of its UI/schema. mock is explicit synthetic preview only.

docs/architecture.md is still 'discussion draft 0.1' and says product is not a replacement provider client; this conflicts with agreed first-class Agent/workflow scope. Its encrypted content vault, remote judge and DuckDB edges are proposals, not confirmed runtime composition.

The actual architecture uses an immutable trusted registry/dependency graph, injected ports/adapters, consent at ingress, ephemeral redaction previews, typed evidence authority, immutable versioned sealed receipts, append-only migrations, and exact-cohort ratio-of-sums aggregation.

Measured and experimental paths must be separate graph lanes. Twenty contract definitions are not twenty measurable values for every session; catalog source says 18 conditional paths plus two adapter gaps, eight experimental estimate paths and zero model-authoritative measured metrics.

Claim-grounding census/review/link implementation is newer local work and explicitly proposal-only: measured=false, metric_authority_established=false. It does not close outcome.agent_claim_grounding.

Historical real-model diagnostic pilots fail semantic comparison gates despite structural tests. Quote presence proves location, not entailment. Do not advertise model interpretation/pooling/live radar as ready from source or synthetic test counts.

Two front-end live surfaces coexist: LiveMiniWindow serves legacy session/project timelines; ModelEnsembleOverlay serves canonical live metric watch. Document route/composition and avoid representing them as one interchangeable component.
V1 compatibility publication service is explicitly read-only preview with withheld metrics, separate from canonical all-twenty head. Keep separate in diagrams and fallback UX.

Large-file coupling observed via nonempty line counts: session_model_ensemble.py 3990; sqlite/model_ensemble.py 3589; probabilistic_metrics.py 1388; model_ensemble_watch.py 1117; ModelEnsemblePanel.tsx 1006; ModelEnsembleOverlay.tsx 1253. Extract by authority/use-case after current behavior is characterized; do not rewrite frozen historical projection versions.

Several key paths differ from origin/main: onboarding, operability, requirement-plan/action evidence, probabilistic contracts, session ensemble orchestration, watch, ensemble persistence and radar/overlay. claim_grounding_links.py is absent from origin/main. Current source diagrams must identify this dirty-tree scope and cannot imply a fresh main checkout contains it.

Stable inspected paths match origin/main: ingest/privacy, provider adapters, OTLP route, trusted registry/deterministic engine, canonical contract_v2, projection_v8, session/project aggregation, calibration ratings, prompt check/hook and model ensemble runtime.

Prioritize closure: recoverable source cohort and exact gate diagnostics; data/provider completeness and two authoritative adapters; model semantic qualification and pooling; one complete current store/API/radar/native journey; current all-state aggregation/calibration tests; release artifact acceptance.

Suggested ADR updates: product boundary amendment; canonical metric publication vs preview ownership; measured/proposal/predictive authority lanes; complete denominator semantics and unknown states; source capability/version qualification; bounded worker ownership and cleanup; aggregate compatibility/estimand policy; demo/live separation; owner-only PR review/merge authority.

Existing pattern: strict versioned Pydantic contracts, application services with repository Protocol ports, SQLite adapters, loopback HTTP and matching strict frontend wire contracts. This is a modular monolith with adapter boundaries, not microservices.
Agent authored projects/history form a different bounded context from imported provider analytics projects/sessions. The UI and documentation must preserve this distinction.

Agent history uses an append-only journal and deterministic projection; raw tool arguments/results and reusable approval authority are deliberately excluded. Durable metadata alone does not promise readable retained conversation history.

Native authority is a separate in-process one-shot capability from bearer auth/CSRF; recovered chats and persisted MCP settings do not recover authority. Changes should preserve exact identity, revision, expiry and request binding.

MCP has three distinct roles: registry discovery/cache, reviewed managed hosting/tool invocation, and exposing the Agent control surface to clients. Combining these in one broad MCP box obscures separate trust and lifecycle boundaries.
